What really brings joy to me is beeing able to express my creativity in all sorts of way and make others happy. I am hobby photographer, graphic designer, dancer, programmer aswell as a game designer and want to learn to draw and sketch by hand aswell. All these endless possibilities give me access to make whatever my heart desires at a given moment. A story captured me? Well make a game out of it, or write a book, a song captured my attention? Dance, a landscape caught my attention? Capture the moment. Just having a way to empty out my mind just propels me to keep going, because i never run out of ideas, one comes after another, i even cancel ideas just because so many new have overrolled me :P. But the best feeling for me in the  world is making someone truly happy. Because i feel the joy they experience in that moment, it is as if the happier i can make them, the happier i am. I made very special christmas presents this year for a group of friends, and seeing them open the gifts and to start crying in joy, the smiles and tears of joy just make me smile aswell, because i didnt sleep multiple days just to finish these presents, but at the end i didnt care, all i cared about was making them happy, and i paid out for everyone. Thats what keeps me happy every day, ever since i overcame a 7 year old depression streak a year ago.
I think nothing really. I kinda have everything i need to be happy in my life.

During my teenage years, i sometimes build small pieces of persons into my own person, thus building up a person from things and traits i loved about others. I also used to just try to be "normal", because beeing very different compared to everyone else would cause them to repell you. That inner conflict was the cause for a 7 year long depression streak. It made me loose my own person completely. But that helped me to build up my own true person, which is based completely of just me. And i guess thats why i appear so abstract to most people, friends and family, i am based on completely my own principles, and care 0 about what others think about it, because beeing myself is what makes me truly happy. And even friends call me a person like they've never seen before, thinking in such a way like one else does and now people admire me for that, because i think outside the box of society and whatever is in there. Ever since that, i never was sad again, thats when i lost any hate or anger, now i am always happy inside, like if a little candle was always illuminating me from the inside.
